title: Settings
intro: Bring your own key. Requests go straight from your browser to the provider, with no server in between.

connect.heading: 2. Connect
connect.ollamaHint: Make sure Ollama is running (ollama serve). Click Save to grant access, then pick a model that supports chat.
connect.lmstudioHint: Start the local server in LM Studio (Developer → Start server) and enable CORS.

model.heading: 3. Model
model.idPlaceholder: Model id, or load the list

summary.displayTabHint: A new tab opens next to the page with a full-width, interactive summary.
summary.displaySidepanelHint: The summary opens in the side panel, next to the page you are reading.
summary.customPlaceholder: e.g. Focus on technical details. Always include a “Why it matters” section.

lengthHints.short: TL;DR and up to 3 key points. Best for a quick look.
lengthHints.medium: TL;DR, key figures, 3–6 points and folded details. A good default.
lengthHints.detailed: Everything important, with depth kept in folded sections.

summary.alwaysIncludeHint: Applied to every new summary. You can still add them later with the buttons under a summary.

actionItems.title: Action items
actionItems.desc: A short checklist of concrete things you can do or decide. Skipped when the source has nothing actionable.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.desc: Key dates, events or stages in order. Skipped when the source has no sequence.

simpler.title: Beginner-friendly
simpler.desc: Plain words, short sentences, and a quick explanation of each technical term.

appearance.previewTldr: White roofs cut indoor heat by up to 4°C in summer.

advanced.maxChars: Max characters sent to the model
advanced.privacy: Keys are stored only in this browser (chrome.storage.local) and are never synced.

permissionDenied: Permission for the API domain was denied.
savedNoPermission: Saved, but permission for the API domain was denied. Requests may fail.

about.tagline: Summarize any page, keep what matters.
about.supportText: Siftlume is free and open source. If it saves you time, a coffee helps keep it going.
